description: SceneTrees on Intel Sponza: GPU first trees then tinybvh swapped in, gpuTreeOutputs copy and adopt and copy with merged static instances, uncapped (gpuMaxBatchBytes: Infinity), and copy with the default cap (256 MiB) and gpuMaxBatchBytes of 512, 256 and 128 MiB; capped rows' peak gated at storage plus one batch; the BX.20 levers (adopt and copy with trimWhenRefined, gated at a node buffer of its trees' size; parents 'refit'; quantized with batched quantize passes against per-tree); memory (GPU-tree state, peak, settled) and times (first trees, tinybvh built). Gate: the GPU walk matches the CPU reference in the GPU-tree state and settled. Needs BVH_ASSETS_DIR and BVH_MANIFESTS_DIR.
